description: Rate-limit-aware paired smoke for machine-inferred lifecycle pseudo labels after GLM-4.7-Flash passed Stage 1 and compressed-message protocol closure was verified.
interpretation_warning: This is an eight-session pipeline smoke over two representative tasks, not a statistical result. Lifecycle states are machine-inferred pseudo labels, not human gold labels. The 20-second inter-run cooldown is fixed and disclosed to reduce transient free-endpoint rate limits.
